targetTexts.1: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
targetTexts.2: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
targetTexts.3: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
targetTexts.4: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me—my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
targetTexts.5: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
targetTexts.6: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
targetTexts.7: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
targetTexts.8: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
targetTexts.9: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
targetTexts.10: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
targetTexts.11: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
targetTexts.12: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
targetTexts.13: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
targetTexts.14: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
targetTexts.15: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
targetTexts.16: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
targetTexts.17: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
targetTexts.18: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
targetTexts.19: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
targetTexts.20: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
targetTexts.21: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
targetTexts.22: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
targetTexts.23: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
targetTexts.24: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
targetTexts.25: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
targetTexts.26: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
targetTexts.27: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
targetTexts.28: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
targetTexts.29: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
targetTexts.30: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
targetTexts.31: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
targetTexts.32: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
targetTexts.33: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
targetTexts.34: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
targetTexts.35: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
targetTexts.36: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
